title: Patterns
parentNote: Do Section A together first (5–10 min). If he gets those right on his own, let him try Section B independently. Section C is for extra challenge — skip it on a tired day!
learnBullets: Spotting what **repeats** in a row of colours, shapes, or numbers
Finding the **missing piece** — at the end OR in the middle
Patterns that **grow** (more and more) or **shrink** (less and less)
Patterns hiding inside a **grid** (like a mini sudoku!)
learnItFirst:
**1. Repeating patterns** — a small group of things repeats again and again.

```
🔴🔵🔴🔵🔴🔵 ...   ← "Red, Blue" repeats forever (this is an AB pattern)
🔴🔵🟡🔴🔵🟡 ...   ← "Red, Blue, Yellow" repeats (this is an ABC pattern)
🟢🔴🔴🟢🔴🔴 ...   ← "Green, Red, Red" repeats (this is an ABB pattern)
```

**2. Growing patterns** — the pattern adds one more thing each time.

```
●   ●●   ●●●   ●●●●   ...   ← one more circle every time!
```

**3. Rotating patterns** — a shape or arrow turns a little bit each time.

```
➡️  ⬇️  ⬅️  ⬆️  ➡️  ⬇️  ...   ← the arrow keeps turning the same way
```

**4. Grid patterns** — every row and every column uses the same shapes, just in a different order (like a puzzle!).

```
▲ ● ■
● ■ ▲
■ ▲ ●
```

### 🧠 How to Solve a Pattern Question — 3 Easy Steps

1. **Look** — what small group of things keeps repeating?
2. **Count** — how many items are in that group before it starts again?
3. **Place** — figure out where the blank falls in that repeating group.

---

questions.why: Pattern is Red, Blue repeating — after Red always comes Blue
▲, ● repeats — after ▲ comes ●
Red, Blue, Yellow repeats — after the 7th (Red) comes Blue
★, ●, ■ repeats — after the 7th (★) comes ●
Blue, Blue, Red repeats — after the 7th (Blue) comes Blue again
Green, Red, Red repeats — after the 7th (Green) comes Red
Small, Medium, Big repeats — after small (7th) comes Medium
Add 2 each time: 8 + 2 = 10
Add 5 each time: 20 + 5 = 25
Add 3 each time: 12 + 3 = 15
▲, ● repeats — the 5th spot lines up with ▲
Red, Blue, Yellow repeats — the 5th spot lines up with Blue
Arrow turns Right→Down→Left→Up on repeat — the 8th spot lines up with Up
Same turning pattern — the 4th spot lines up with Up, matching the 8th spot
🔺, 🔷 repeats — after 🔺 (5th) comes 🔷
One more circle added every time: 4 circles → 5 circles
One more square added every time: 3 squares → 4 squares
Add 10 each time: 40 + 10 = 50
Subtract 2 each time: 14 − 2 = 12

questions.content:
Look at the grid. Each row and column has ▲ ● ■ exactly once. What goes in the `?` box?

```
▲ ● ■
● ■ ▲
■ ▲ ?
```
questions.why: Row 3 already has ■ and ▲, so the missing one must be ●
🔻, 🔺 repeats — after 🔻 (5th) comes 🔺

questions.content:
One shape in this row breaks the Red-Blue pattern. Which position is wrong?
🔴🔵🔴🔵🟡🔴🔵  *(1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th, 6th, 7th)*
questions.why: Pattern should be Red, Blue, Red, Blue... but the 5th spot shows Yellow instead of Red

questions.content:
In this list, one number breaks the "add 2 each time" pattern. Which number is wrong?
2, 4, 6, 9, 10, 12
questions.why: Pattern should add 2 each time (2,4,6,8,10,12) — the 4th number should be 8, not 9
Corner turns ↖→↗→↘→↙ on repeat — the 8th spot lines up with ↙️

questions.content:
Look at the grid. Each row and column has 1, 2, 3 exactly once. What goes in the `?` box?

```
1 2 3
2 3 1
3 1 ?
```
questions.why: Row 3 already has 3 and 1, so the missing number must be 2

questions.content: 1, 3, 6, 10, ___   *(hint: the jump gets bigger each time — +2, +3, +4...)*
questions.why: The jump grows each time: +2, +3, +4, then +5 → 10 + 5 = 15

questions.content: A, C, E, G, ___   *(hint: one letter is skipped each time)*
questions.why: One letter is skipped each time: A,(b),C,(d),E,(f),G,(h),I
Subtract 3 each time: 11 − 3 = 8
Subtract 4 each time: 18 − 4 = 14

questions.content: Triangle (3 sides) → Square (4 sides) → Pentagon (5 sides) → ___
questions.why: Number of sides grows by 1 each time: 3, 4, 5, then 6
